description: This file defines the PageSetup class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for configuring page layout settings such as paper size, orientation, scaling, print areas, and page order for spreadsheet worksheets.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Represents the page setup configuration for a worksheet, including options like paper size, orientation, scaling, print areas, and page order.

methods.name: getPaperSize
methods.description: Returns the current paper size setting, defaulting to LETTER if not set.

methods.name: setPaperSize
methods.description: Sets the paper size based on predefined constants.

methods.name: getPaperSizeDefault
methods.description: Returns the default paper size setting.

methods.name: setPaperSizeDefault
methods.description: Sets the default paper size for new page setups.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current page orientation setting.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the page orientation to landscape, portrait, or default.

methods.name: getOrientationDefault
methods.description: Returns the default orientation setting.

methods.name: setOrientationDefault
methods.description: Defines the default orientation for new page setups.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current print scale percentage.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the print scale, with validation to prevent negative values.

methods.name: getFitToPage
methods.description: Indicates whether the sheet should fit to one page.

methods.name: setFitToPage
methods.description: Enables or disables fitting the sheet to a page.

methods.name: getFitToHeight
methods.description: Returns the number of vertical pages to fit content into.

methods.name: setFitToHeight
methods.description: Sets the number of vertical pages the sheet should be scaled to fit.

methods.name: getFitToWidth
methods.description: Returns the number of horizontal pages to fit content into.

methods.name: setFitToWidth
methods.description: Sets the number of horizontal pages the sheet should be scaled to fit.

methods.name: isColumnsToRepeatAtLeftSet
methods.description: Checks if columns to repeat at the left are configured.

methods.name: getColumnsToRepeatAtLeft
methods.description: Returns the column range set to repeat on the left.

methods.name: setColumnsToRepeatAtLeft
methods.description: Defines the columns to be repeated at the left.

methods.name: setColumnsToRepeatAtLeftByStartAndEnd
methods.description: Sets columns to repeat on the left using start and end column labels.

methods.name: isRowsToRepeatAtTopSet
methods.description: Checks if rows to repeat at the top are configured.

methods.name: getRowsToRepeatAtTop
methods.description: Returns the row range set to repeat at the top.

methods.name: setRowsToRepeatAtTop
methods.description: Defines the rows to repeat at the top.

methods.name: setRowsToRepeatAtTopByStartAndEnd
methods.description: Sets rows to repeat at the top using start and end row numbers.

methods.name: getHorizontalCentered
methods.description: Indicates if the page is horizontally centered.

methods.name: setHorizontalCentered
methods.description: Enables or disables horizontal centering.

methods.name: getVerticalCentered
methods.description: Indicates if the page is vertically centered.

methods.name: setVerticalCentered
methods.description: Enables or disables vertical centering.

methods.name: getPrintArea
methods.description: Returns the defined print area or areas.

methods.name: isPrintAreaSet
methods.description: Checks if a print area is set for a specific index.

methods.name: clearPrintArea
methods.description: Clears the print area for a specific index or all areas.

methods.name: setPrintArea
methods.description: Sets the print area to a specific cell range, with options for overwrite or insert.

methods.name: addPrintArea
methods.description: Adds a new print area, appending to existing ones.

methods.name: setPrintAreaByColumnAndRow
methods.description: Defines a print area using start and end columns and rows.

methods.name: addPrintAreaByColumnAndRow
methods.description: Adds a new print area based on start and end columns and rows.

methods.name: getFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Returns the initial page number for printing.

methods.name: setFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Sets the first page number for printing.

methods.name: resetFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Resets the first page number to default (null).

methods.name: getPageOrder
methods.description: Returns the current page order setting.

methods.name: setPageOrder
methods.description: Sets the page order (over then down or down then over).
